title: Insulation Rebates in Markham 2026: Where the Program Still Pays
desc: Markham insulation rebates for 2026 under Home Renovation Savings: 82% of households own, only 19% of homes predate 1981, and amounts depend on starting R-value.
lead: Markham has 110,870 households and only 19% live in homes built before 1981. The insulation rebates pay by starting R-value, so check what you have before you spend on an assessment.
cards_heading: What Home Renovation Savings pays for insulation in Markham
cards_intro: We re-read the program's pages and both eligibility documents on October 3, 2026. There are two ways in: an attic-only stream with no assessment, and the assessment stream, where insulation, windows, air sealing and a heat pump water heater are bundled.

cards.title: Attic, no assessment
cards.note: The attic stream pays half of the after-tax cost, up to $1,250 for an attic from R-12 or less to R-50, $1,000 from R-25 or less and $800 from R-35 or less. A participating insulation contractor must do the work.

cards.title: Attic, with assessment
cards.note: In the assessment stream an attic brought to at least R-50 pays $1,500, $1,200 or $900 by starting R-value, pro-rated by the share of the roof you insulate (minimum 50%).

cards.title: Cathedral ceiling or flat roof
cards.note: $750 in the attic stream and $780 in the assessment stream. Any combination of attic, cathedral and flat roof counts as one measure, capped at $1,500 in the assessment stream.

cards.title: Exterior walls
cards.note: $1,200 for R-7.5 to R-12 added, $2,100 for more than R-12 to R-20 and $3,600 for more than R-20. Minimum 20% of wall area, pro-rated.

cards.title: Basement walls, slab and headers
cards.note: Walls up to $1,500, a slab $500 and a header $300. Wall plus slab is capped at $2,000, and all three at $2,300.

cards.title: Crawl space and exposed floors
cards.note: Crawl space walls $600 or $1,200, ceiling $1,200, header $300, combined up to $2,700. An exposed floor over a garage earns $300 at R-20 or more.

cards.title: Semis and row homes
cards.note: Semi-detached and end-unit row homes get 75% of the walls and basement maximums. Middle-unit rows get 50%.

cards.title: Audit rebate and cap
cards.note: The assessment stream returns $600 for the audits and caps insulation rebates at $7,700, inside an overall $10,000 limit, or $5,000 for Enbridge gas homes.

after_cards: Attic stream work must be finished by November 30, 2026 and entered in the system by December 31. In the assessment stream, the post-audit must be scheduled by November 30 and completed by December 31, 2026, or within 180 days of your first assessment.
sections: The 2021 Census counts 12,100 owner-occupied detached houses built before 1981 in Markham. About 21% of households live in homes built since 2011. 77% live in an eligible house type, 82% own and 3.0% report needing major repairs. Older houses in the original village areas and the 1970s subdivisions are the candidates.

The attic rebate shrinks as the starting R-value rises: $1,500 from R-12 or less, $1,200 from R-12 to R-25 and $900 from R-25 to R-35 in the assessment stream, and $1,250, $1,000 and $800 in the attic stream. Above R-35 the tables do not apply. A house with R-30 in the attic gets at most $900 or $800 for topping up to R-50.

Markham has 7,095 semi-detached and 16,100 row households. Semis and end-unit rows receive 75% of the wall and basement maximums, and middle-unit rows 50%. Stacked townhomes are excluded, and there are no rebates for walls shared with a neighbour.
Which stream for a small job

If only the attic needs work, the attic stream avoids the $600 assessment cost and the second upgrade. It pays half of the after-tax cost up to its maximum, so it can pay less than the assessment stream's pro-rated amount when the job is cheap. If you plan walls or basement too, the assessment stream is the only route.
claim_steps: Measure the current attic insulation and note the R-value.
Choose a stream: pre-register for the attic stream, or book a home energy assessment for the full bundle.
Get quotes that state the R-value you start with, the R-value you reach and the share of each surface you will insulate.
Do not start any work until the in-home visit or first assessment has happened.
Keep invoices and your property tax bill for the paperwork, and finish before the November 30 and December 31, 2026 dates.
faq: Is a newer Markham house eligible?
Only if its attic starts at R-35 or less.
Do I need an assessment for the attic?
No, the attic stream has its own in-home visit.
